_doc: Ground-truth expectations per validation sample. Used by run_validation_cohort.sh to grade pipeline outputs.

JURKAT.biology: T-ALL cell line, monoclonal at TRA + TRB

NAMALWA.biology: Burkitt B-cell lymphoma cell line, monoclonal IGH (and IGK/IGL)

DAUDI.biology: Burkitt B-cell lymphoma cell line. Monoclonal IGH (specific V allele varies in literature; consensus is heavily-SHM'd IGHV gene, often IGHV3 or IGHV4 family). Originally derived 1968; subcloning across labs has produced slight variation.

PBMC_HEALTHY.biology: Healthy donor peripheral blood (CellPlex 3'-biased RNA-seq). With 3'-biased libraries the IG/TCR 5' ends are not sequenced, so V(D)J yield is expected to be zero. Pipeline should produce no_signal — the correct clinical answer for this library type.
